failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is greater than the prior 28-day mean (-16.4) despite TRANSIT staying below -50.

mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES weekly mean crosses above -40, it signals a policy-driven return-to-office that increases weekday retail footfall, raising RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: The post-holiday January trough, visible in RETAIL_REC falling from -9.4 to -23.0, typically bottoms in late January and rebounds in early February as school and work routines resume, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is lower than or equal to the prior 28-day mean (-16.4) during the post-holiday January trough.
